module_summary: Sequential 16x16 shift-and-add multiplier: one-hot 3-state FSM loads operands, accumulates masked shifted multiplicand for 16 cycles, then pulses done.

anchors.name: st
anchors.why: One-hot state register: idle, iterate, finish; gates load, accumulate and busy.

anchors.name: sum
anchors.why: Product accumulator adding partial product each iteration; drives p.

anchors.name: mcand
anchors.why: Multiplicand operand latched from a, shifted left each iteration.

anchors.name: mplier
anchors.why: Multiplier operand latched from b, shifted right; LSB gates partial product.

anchors.name: ctr
anchors.why: Iteration counter; reaching 16 ends iterate state.

anchors.name: s
anchors.why: Start command; in idle loads operands and enters iterate.

anchors.name: d
anchors.why: Registered one-cycle done pulse from finish state, accompanying product.

anchors.name: part
anchors.why: Partial product: multiplicand masked by multiplier LSB.

anchors.name: load
anchors.why: Operand load enable: idle and start clears sum and counter.

anchors.name: last
anchors.why: Counter equals 16; triggers transition to finish.

groups.name: mul_controller
groups.description: One-hot idle/iterate/finish FSM producing load, busy and done.

groups.name: shift_add_datapath
groups.description: Shifted multiplicand, shifting multiplier and accumulating adder.
